title: Seacrest Beach "Waterhouse Condo 203" 8377 East County Highway 30A #203
h1: Seacrest Beach "Waterhouse Condo 203" 8377 East County Highway 30A #203
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:-Distance to Beach Access: 100 Feet (1 Minute Walk)-Rooftop Pool with Stunning Panoramic Views-Parking Spaces: 2 Spaces in Lot-Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 7, Bar Seating for 5-Coffee Maker Available-Community Grill Available-Waterhouse Provisions + Bottleshop (located on 1st floor of building)-Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforters, are laundered upon every checkout. DETAILS: Experience a sunny, slow-paced getaway at Waterhouse Condo 203. Tucked across the street from the Timpoochee Trail and Gulf, this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom Seacrest Beach property sleeps up to 8 guests. Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and The Big Chill are all nearby for delicious eats and entertainment, or explore the area’s beautiful nature preserves, coastal lakes, and pristine beaches. Guests will love spending days at the rooftop community pool with panoramic views or relaxing by the shore—beach access is only 100 feet away!Comfort and elegance combine inside this charming single-story condo. Enter to discover rich, multi-toned wood floors, a wall of sunlit windows, and deep blue accents adding warmth to the great room’s refined furnishings. The fully equipped kitchen is thoughtfully designed with high-end appliances and a vast 15-foot island that seats 5—perfect for entertaining taste-testers! Up to 7 can gather around the dining table, or head outside to eat alfresco on the balcony’s 8-person table. Relax afterwards with a nightcap in the adjacent outdoor seating area as the sea air offers a refreshing breeze. Inside, plenty of soft seating and a TV invite guests to unwind in the living space. When the night comes to an end, retire to the peaceful primary bedroom featuring a king bed and balcony access or the 2 guest bedrooms, each with a queen bed. For added comfort and convenience, all the bedrooms feature a Smart TV, and the living area has a queen sleeper sofa.Quick beach access and delightful outdoor spaces make Waterhouse Condo 203 an excellent base for discovering Seacrest Beach. Exploring is easy with parking for 2 vehicles, or take advantage of the 3 complimentary adult bikes and hop on the Timpoochee Trail. For beach access, cross East County Highway 30A at the crosswalk, and the beach boardwalk will be on the left. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 8):SECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Living Room: Queen Sofa Sleeper*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and Callista Vacation Rentals fines.*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
